behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.29.0: the configuration registry moves from 28 to 29, the execution plan from 12 to 13, and the daemon IPC schema from 11 to 12; every other counter is 0.29.0's (configuration schema 6, command record 3, job manifest and summary 3, plan report 2, credential package 2, scoreboard 3, audit 1); a daemon serves only a client of its own build, its IPC schema and Go build ID, and a client that launches its own daemon drains one of another build and starts its own, a busy one finishing its jobs and exiting after the last; daemon status stacks the daemon's values over the client's; a drained daemon exits after its last job, and every stop names its mode; karvi version and the job manifest name the build and no build time; the service account's daemon under the package's system template karvi-daemon@.service, set up by karvi-sysutil, daemon.launch saying who starts the account's daemon, and the user daemon unit removed; the bundle installs itself (scripts/install.sh); daemon.socket replaced by the socket directory daemon.sockets; one read of the configuration per invocation, its warnings said by every invocation; a credential helper (creds.helper), %operator% in the credential templates, an explicit env:NAME cell or field, env-indirection and the sqlite backend type removed, and the store backends' keys and the transforms checked at load; the transports' own SSH algorithm lists; a stream's --restart; refusals in colour and no colour in a file; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.29.0 daemon the client's daemon status found no daemon of its own (daemon_unreachable, exit 110), its run's exercise started one on d.sock (exit 0, no device contacted), and each executable stopped its own daemon (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)

configuration_migration.notes: the configuration schema is unchanged from v0.10.0; config.schema-version stays 6; registry 29 (28 at v0.29.0): daemon.socket replaced by daemon.sockets; without a further bump, daemon.launch, creds.helper, creds.helper-enabled, creds.helper-timeout, creds.helper-unavailable, and ssh-algorithms.source added, and name.default-transform, the backends' env-indirection flags, and the sqlite backend type's keys removed
